title: jasminum scandens var. laetum
intro: Jasminum scandens var. laetum, commonly known as Golden Star Jasmine, is a climbing plant native to tropical Asia, characterized by its bright yellow, star-shaped flowers and dark green leaves. The Golden Star Jasmine has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, promoting a sense of calmness and well-being. The bioactive constituents of the Golden Star Jasmine include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
